Three-point chromosome contacts

Choose a bait on the circular chromosome. The left map shows how often pairs of regions meet in condensin simulations. The right map predicts where two other regions meet the chosen bait.


404 bins at 10 kb spacing. The color scales saturate at 0.25 for pairs and 0.005 for triplets. The dark lines through the bait mark bins excluded by the model.
